analysis.summary: ASK Automotive reported strong Q1 FY27 financial results, marked by record quarterly revenue, EBITDA, and PAT. Management highlighted robust year-on-year revenue growth driven by strong performance across all business segments and a recovery in the Indian two-wheeler industry. The company revised its full-year growth guidance to high-teens and scaled up its projected capital expenditure for the year. Additionally, management noted operational progress in green energy captives, technical collaborations, and new order wins. ASK Automotive reported its Q1 FY27 financial results, highlighting record quarterly revenue, EBITDA, and PAT with consolidated net revenue up 52.1% year-on-year.

guidance.claim: The company revised its full-year growth guidance from mid-teens to high-teens.
guidance.quote: We are confident that we will continue to grow not only in mid-teens, but we will be now growing for the full year in high teens.

guidance.claim: Management expects exports to increase by 20% in the current financial year.
guidance.quote: Last year, we could not go near the target anywhere, but this time, we have given a guidance of 20% increase in the exports, and at the moment, we are still very confident we'll achieve it.

guidance.claim: The company is confident that it will continue to grow around mid-teens in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are confident that will continue to grow around mid-teens in FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic demand remains robust and private consumption is resilient.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic demand remains robust, private consumption is resilient, and the Government of India's structural reforms, particularly GST 2.0, continue to energize the broader economy and, importantly for us the automobile sector, given its deep forward and backward linkages.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains optimistic about medium-term industry outlook supported by consumer sentiment and expected benefits from the 8th Pay Commission.
demand_outlook.quote: We also remain optimistic on the medium-term industry outlook, supported by improving consumer sentiment, expected benefits from the 8th Pay Commission, and continued policy support for manufacturing and formalization through labor reforms.

demand_outlook.claim: OEM customers are continuing with their original production schedules showing growth for the year.
demand_outlook.quote: As far outlook of the two-wheeler industry is concerned, our all our OEM customers they are carrying on with their original production schedules which shows a nice growth in this year also and none of the supplies have been affected by the raw materials or anything.

demand_outlook.claim: Independent aftermarket sales grew by 24.7% in FY26 following the GST rate reduction from 28% to 18%.
demand_outlook.quote: Happy to share that our independent aftermarket has grown by 24.7% in FY26.

demand_outlook.claim: The EV segment is currently growing at a single-digit rate.
demand_outlook.quote: The EV segment is growing still at single digit, and we are also growing with the EV segment.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's full-year capital expenditure may increase to around Rs. 700 crore due to new orders.
capex_expansion.quote: We had given guidance about around Rs. 450 crore to Rs. 500 crore, but the way we are going and receiving the orders, as I today revised the guidance to high-teens, I think our capex may go to something like Rs. 700 crore this year.

capex_expansion.claim: A new plant needs to be urgently set up in Bangalore for new orders.
capex_expansion.quote: That is the need that we have to urgently set up for the new orders that have come. We have to set up a new plant in South, that will be in Bangalore at a war footing, and we hope to operationalize it before March in this financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatts at Bikaner is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatts at Bikaner, Rajasthan is ready and is expected to be commissioned in Q2FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company operationalized a 9.9 MWp solar power plant for captive consumption.
capex_expansion.quote: 9.9 MWp Solar Power Plant for captive consumption operationalized.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's second captive solar plant in Bikaner is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatt in Bikaner, Rajasthan is progressing well and is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27, this reflects ASK's special focus on green energy.

capex_expansion.claim: For next year's mid-teens growth, the company needs to invest around Rs. 400 Cr in FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: For next year growth of mid-teens, we need to invest around RS.400 Cr which we shall be investing in this year also.

margins_costs.claim: The payback of investment in the captive solar plant is estimated to be in five and a half years.
margins_costs.quote: We can't quantify that number exactly, but we know very well that our payback of the investment is in five and a half years.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins stood at 12.0% for Q1 FY27.
EBITDA margin was impacted in Q4 FY26 due to pass-through alloy prices by 80 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin at 12.1%, however, this EBITDA percentage was impacted due to pass-through alloy prices as mentioned earlier. For this impact, EBITDA percentage would have been higher by 80 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: For FY26, EBITDA margin was 13.1% and would have been higher by 40 basis points without the alloy price pass-through impact.
margins_costs.quote: We achieved EBITDA of Rs. 551 Cr with 24.1% year-on-year growth. EBITDA margin at 13.1%, however, EBITDA percentage was impacted due to pass-through alloy prices. For this impact, EBITDA percentage would have been higher by 40 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: The company aims to sustain the current level of EBITDA margins and gradually improve them.
margins_costs.quote: Our aim is to sustain current level of EBITDA margins and continue our efforts to improve gradually in the subsequent quarters, depending upon the growth of the two-wheeler industry and geopolitical environment.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has confirmed orders of about Rs. 70 crore to Rs. 90 crore for alloy wheels this financial year.
orders_capacity.quote: We have confirmed orders of about Rs. 70 crore to Rs. 90 crore depending on how the customer gear up for this financial year.

orders_capacity.claim: Confirmed orders for alloy wheels for next financial year stand at about Rs. 250 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: However, for next financial year, we have confirmed orders of about Rs. 250 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: Exports to Ford Motors are expected to be about Rs. 40 to Rs. 45 crore this year and go up to Rs. 60 crore next year.
orders_capacity.quote: As regards your second question of Ford Motors, we will be doing exports of about Rs. 40 to Rs. 45 crore this year, and next year, it is likely to go up to Rs. 60 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the Karoli plant has reached about 75%.
orders_capacity.quote: happy to share that against the installed capacity in Karoli plant, from 60% to 65% that we were in the last quarter, we have now gone up to about 75%, and we are confident that in the last Q4, we will be around 80% of the capacity utilization

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the third Bengaluru plant has reached 90%.
orders_capacity.quote: Very, very happy to share that Bangalore we have reached 90% capacity utilization that we set up last year, our 18th plant and the third plant in Bengaluru. The Bangalore all capacities are full now.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the Karoli plant is currently at 65%.
orders_capacity.quote: In the Karoli plant, the capacities utilization is still 65%, that is the reason that we have made investment for the alloy wheels.

capital_allocation.claim: Internal accruals will be sufficient for growth, but external financing will be used for cash flow management.
capital_allocation.quote: We are actually keeping in mind our high mid-teen growth, our internal accruals will be sufficient; but yes, for cash flow management, we will have to take some external financing.

capital_allocation.claim: Management remains confident that the debt-to-equity ratio will remain under control and not exceed 0.5.
capital_allocation.quote: We are still very confident that our debt equity will remain under control and it will be not exceed 0.5.

capital_allocation.claim: The board has recommended a dividend of 92.5%, amounting to Rs. 1.85 per equity share.
capital_allocation.quote: The board has recommended a dividend of 92.5%, that is Rs. 1.85 per equity share of face value of Rs. 2 each.

capital_allocation.claim: Internal accruals and free cash will be ploughed back into the company while containing debt levels.
capital_allocation.quote: All these internal accruals free cash will be ploughed back in the company, so we will see to it even the debt levels are contained within the limits.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflict in West Asia caused volatility and a sharp increase in aluminum alloy prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: As you are aware, after 28th February 2026, the geopolitical conflict in West Asia had created undue volatility in energy, commodity, and currency markets, and had led to a sharp, phenomenal increase in aluminum alloy prices, which affected our industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Volatility in alloy prices may affect margin percentages due to the denominator effect.
risks_headwinds.quote: Volatility in alloy prices may affect margin percentages due to the denominator effect.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflicts in West Asia disrupted the global economy and caused volatility in energy, commodities, and currencies.
risks_headwinds.quote: After 28th February, 2026, geopolitical conflict in West Asia has disrupted the global economy, posing an unprecedented challenge in supply chain, creating undue volatility in energy, commodity and currency across the globe and it has started affecting Indian economy as well.

risks_headwinds.claim: Revenue from exports declined to Rs. 141 Cr in FY26 due to trade disruptions, higher tariffs, geopolitical tensions, and supply chain issues.
risks_headwinds.quote: Our revenue from exports were at Rs. 141 Cr in FY26 against Rs. 147 Cr last year because of the trade disruptions due to higher tariff rates, geopolitical tensions, supply chain issues, logistic costs and other bottlenecks. We could not achieve our target on the export front.

management_commitments.claim: The Bikaner captive solar plant is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatts at Bikaner, Rajasthan is ready and is expected to be commissioned in Q2FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to operationalize the new plant in Bangalore before March in the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We have to set up a new plant in South, that will be in Bangalore at a war footing, and we hope to operationalize it before March in this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: Initial sun-roof cable supplies will start from H2.
management_commitments.quote: Initial supplies will start from H2, but next year, you will see substantial growth there.

management_commitments.claim: The second captive solar plant in Bikaner, Rajasthan is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatt in Bikaner, Rajasthan is progressing well and is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27, this reflects ASK's special focus on green energy.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects alloy wheel revenue of around Rs. 90 to Rs. 100 Cr in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: FY27 we are expecting revenue of around Rs. 90 - Rs. 100 Cr and FY28 will be about Rs. 220 Cr.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to spend about Rs. 400 Cr on capex in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: FY27 we'll be spending about Rs. 400 Cr.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
